title: Save immutable sheet-layout revisions
description: Persist validated geometry changes as immutable `SheetLayoutRevision` records under a stable `SheetLayout` identity while retaining every prior revision.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a sheet layout creates a stable layout identity and revision 1
Saving changed validated geometry appends a new monotonically numbered immutable revision
Prior revisions remain readable and unchanged after later saves
Saving is rejected while structured geometry refusals exist
A project or caller can reference an exact revision rather than a mutable latest value
Revision records include schema version, timestamps, normalized geometry, source disclosures, derivation disclosures, and radius state

steps.details: Separate stable `SheetLayout` identity/provenance from immutable `SheetLayoutRevision` geometry and disclosure fields with explicit schema and revision numbers.
Add atomic create-layout, append-revision, get-revision, and list-revisions operations; reject overwrite of an existing layout ID plus revision number.
Accept only validated normalized geometry and its source/derivation disclosures at the repository boundary; do not let form-state types satisfy the save API.
Make first save create revision 1 and subsequent geometry save append the next revision while preserving stable layout identity.
Create two revisions, reload from IndexedDB, and assert revision 1 is byte-for-byte equivalent to its original durable value while revision 2 contains the edit.

technicalNotes: Never update a revision in place; corrections are new revisions.
Use a transaction that cannot advance revision numbering without storing the corresponding record.
